children: Zumiez Inc reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $209M, a slight decline from $214.3M a year earlier, and a net loss of $2.7M, or $(0.17) per diluted share, compared with a net loss of $1M, or $(0.06) per diluted share, in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue: $209.0M for the three months ended Aug 1, 2026, down from $214.3M in the year-ago quarter ( (2.5%) ).
Net income: Net loss of $2.7M for the three months ended Aug 1, 2026, versus net loss of $1.0M in the year-ago quarter.
Diluted EPS: $(0.17) loss per diluted share for the three months ended Aug 1, 2026, versus $(0.06) loss per diluted share in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue trend: Net sales declined 2.5% in Q2 but are up 0.9% year-to-date, reflecting mixed comparable-sales performance across channels.
Channel shift: The integrated store and ecommerce model continued to drive results, with ecommerce included in comparable-sales reporting and producing mixed outcomes.
Brand momentum: Strength was seen in men's clothing, accessories and hardgoods, while footwear and women's apparel underperformed.
Store footprint: The company recorded a net closure of 16 stores and plans roughly five new store openings for fiscal 2026 alongside remodel activity.
Operational cash & capex: Operating cash use increased; full-year FY26 capital expenditure guidance is $13–15M focused on fixtures and remodels.
